headlines.title: UFC head Dana White says he’ll meet with Trump Monday on press secretary offer
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said that he’d offered the job of White House press secretary to the CEO and president of the Ultimate Fighting Championship, Dana White.

headlines.title: Armed man arrested near White House for allegedly threatening Trump
headlines.description: The Secret Service said a Venezuelan migrant in the U.S. illegally was arrested with an arsenal of weapons in his car near the White House and threatened to kill President Trump. NBC News’ Tom Winter reports.

headlines.title: Newly-elected House Dem: Trump didn't listen to voters in elevating Stephen Miller
headlines.description: Democratic Rep.-elect Cait Conley joins Meet the Press NOW fresh off of her win against Rep. Mike Lawler in New York’s 17th congressional district as President Trump announced he will make Stephen Miller the new White House chief of staff.

headlines.title: Trump names Stephen Miller as new White House chief of staff after midterm losses
headlines.description: President Trump announces Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez, Julia Ainsley, Scott Wong and Sahil Kapur join Meet the Press Now to discuss President Trump’s first major shakeup after the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Trump names Stephen Miller his new chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has turned to MAGA favorite Stephen Miller to lead the White House after Republicans got trounced in Tuesday’s midterm elections, losing both chambers of Congress by wide margins.

headlines.title: The White House’s post-election shake-up: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dive into President Donald Trump’s decision to make a change at chief of staff. Plus, Kristen Welker examines how voters once again rejected the status quo.

headlines.title: Florida candidate sues election official, alleging bias in a razor-thin race
headlines.description: MIAMI — South Florida Democratic congressional candidate Eliott Rodriguez filed a federal lawsuit against the Miami-Dade supervisor of elections Friday, citing bias after she declined to recuse herself from the recount process.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy discharged from hospital after stroke
headlines.description: The Connecticut Democrat will spend “several weeks at a rehabilitation center” after being discharged from The Johns Hopkins Hospital in Baltimore, Maryland.

headlines.title: Top DOJ officials resign after midterm landslide, including head of ‘grand conspiracy’ investigation
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Donald Trump appointee who headed the office running a “grand conspiracy” investigation into federal law enforcement officials who were involved in prior investigations of Trump has resigned.

headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after commission’s approval
headlines.description: The Trump administration has said it expects to begin construction immediately, but a judge is considering a plan to temporarily halt the project.
